title: 2024 Topps Chrome Baseball #231 Dansby Swanson X-Fractor Refractor Chicago Cubs
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The 2024 Topps Chrome Baseball #231 Dansby Swanson X-Fractor Refractor card features a standard size card of Major League Baseball player Dansby Swanson from the Chicago Cubs. This original card is part of the 2024 Topps Chrome set and includes an X-Fractor parallel variety, making it a unique addition to any collection. Manufactured by Topps in the United States, this English-language sports trading card is a must-have for fans and collectors alike.
